name: GAIA
description: A benchmark of 466 real-world assistant tasks testing general AI assistant capabilities across three difficulty levels. Tasks require combinations of web browsing, file reading, multi-step reasoning, tool use, and mathematical calculations — all steps humans naturally perform. Human solvers (with tools) achieve ~92% accuracy; AI agents showed large performance gaps at launch.
typical_sota_score: ~60–75% (top agents as of 2025; human with tools ~92%)
reputation: Key benchmark for general AI assistant capability; developed by Meta AI and HuggingFace; provides human reference performance for agentic tasks; used in HELM and major evaluation reports
notes: Three difficulty levels: Level 1 (tool-free or minimal), Level 2 (multi-tool), Level 3 (complex multi-step). Requires exact string answers verified against ground truth. Tasks are grounded in real-world questions with verifiable answers. Published at NeurIPS 2023 workshop. HuggingFace hosts the evaluation leaderboard. Meta AI and HuggingFace collaboration.
